capabilityRouteMappings.authRequirement: public with Wasm route rate limits and duplicate-send guards

safety.approval: not required for normal verification resend; host rate limits and anti-abuse checks required
safety.idempotency: hash normalized email, purpose, and active verification window; never log the email value

capabilityRouteMappings.authRequirement: public token flow with replay protection

safety.approval: not required for valid verification token redemption
safety.idempotency: token hash and verification purpose; replay returns redacted success or validation failure

redactionRules: do not log raw request body

safety.approval: agent should confirm user intent before revoking all sessions
safety.idempotency: authenticated account and host request id; repeated calls remain safe when no active sessions remain

capabilityRouteMappings.authRequirement: bearer-token plus exactly one currently enrolled factor: TOTP code or unused recoveryCode

safety.approval: agent must confirm explicit user intent before disabling MFA
safety.idempotency: authenticated account and MFA state; repeated disable requests return redacted status

capabilityRouteMappings.authRequirement: system-admin write or exact host-attested bearer capability

safety.idempotency: atomic first-use token initialization; matching relationships are preserved; incompatible configuration fails closed

redactionRules: never return or log service tokens
only return readiness and bounded probe status
